note: Every file the ETL reads. fetch.py downloads each to data/raw/ and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs: a changed source must be reviewed, not silently absorbed. Entries marked manual sit behind a firewall that blocks scripts: download them by hand into data/raw/. Their hashes record exactly which file was read.

sources.title: Take part in the democratic process: petitions, deputations and public questions to Full Council, with the 2026-27 deadlines
sources.note: Read in a browser on 11 October 2026 (the server refuses scripted requests). Petitions: 100 signatures go to the Cabinet Member, 250 to a Cabinet debate, 5,000 to a Full Council debate. Deputations: up to 10 residents, the form signed by 10 electors, three working days before the meeting. Public questions: one question to the Leader or a Cabinet Member, in writing at least seven clear working days before the meeting, by 12 noon; deadlines for 2026-27 listed by meeting.
